## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Cline #14426 reasoning token double-counting fix - HIGH PRIORITY (provider + core)

- **What**: Cline PR #14426 "fix(llms): stop double-counting reasoning tokens in outputTokens" merged 2026-09-26 03:10 UTC fixed reasoning token accounting. Providers report reasoning tokens as a SUBSET of `outputTokens`/`completion_tokens` (e.g. OpenAI's `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`), NOT additional to it. `normalizeUsage()` already extracted `reasoningTokenCount` as its own field but left the raw `outputTokens` untouched, so every consumer of usage totals (session totals, telemetry, Harbor's `n_output_tokens` for eval harnesses) double-counted reasoning tokens: once folded into `outputTokens`, and again as `reasoningTokenCount`. Fix: subtract `reasoningTokenCount` out of the returned `outputTokens` (clamped at 0), so `outputTokens` reflects the actual non-reasoning output. Cost is still computed from the pre-subtraction total, since reasoning tokens are billed at the output rate — only the exposed token count changes, not billing. Also fixed AI SDK v4's nested `outputTokens.reasoning` shape (REASONING_TOKEN_PATHS only checked flat/details-object reasoning fields, missed v4 shape where reasoning lives at `outputTokens.reasoning`, so `reasoningTokenCount` stayed 0 and subtraction was no-op, leaving reasoning tokens still double-counted for v4-shaped usage). Also threaded `reasoningTokenCount` through `task.tokens` telemetry event (`captureTokenUsage`, built from `legacyTokenUsageFromUsageEvent`) and added `reasoningTokenCount` to `AgentUsageEvent`, so reasoning tokens are reported separately instead of vanishing from telemetry. Tests: assert `outputTokens` reduced by `reasoningTokenCount` when both present, clamp at 0 rather than negative, pricing-fallback cost bills full pre-subtraction output count. 885 passed in `sdk/packages/llms`, 94 passed in `sdk/packages/agents` (covers cumulative session-usage summing).

- **Why**: **Alexi has the same bug**. `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` L127-135 defines `TokenUsage` interface with `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `total_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens`, `cache_creation_input_tokens`, but NO `reasoningTokenCount` field. SAP AI Core Orchestration proxies OpenAI models (GPT-5.6, GPT-6) and Anthropic models with extended thinking (Opus 4.x, Sonnet 4.x), which report reasoning tokens as a subset of `completion_tokens`. If Alexi adds `reasoningTokenCount` to `TokenUsage` without the subtraction fix, cumulative session totals (src/core/sessionManager.ts, src/core/costTracker.ts) would double-count reasoning tokens. Cline's fix prevents this: extract `reasoningTokenCount`, subtract it from `completion_tokens` before exposing `outputTokens`, compute cost from pre-subtraction total (reasoning billed at output rate). Implementation path: (1) add `reasoningTokenCount?: number` to `TokenUsage` interface (src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts L127-135), (2) extract reasoning tokens from provider response in `parseOrchestrationResponse` / `parseStreamChunk` (check OpenAI `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`, Anthropic `usage.thinking_tokens` or `usage.reasoning_tokens`, AI SDK v4 `usage.outputTokens.reasoning`), (3) subtract `reasoningTokenCount` from `completion_tokens` before returning `TokenUsage` (clamp at 0), (4) compute cost from pre-subtraction `completion_tokens + reasoningTokenCount` (reasoning billed at output rate), (5) thread `reasoningTokenCount` through session totals (src/core/sessionManager.ts, cumulative usage summing, src/core/costTracker.ts), (6) add telemetry field if Alexi has telemetry events for token usage, (7) write tests (reasoning tokens subtracted from outputTokens, clamp at 0, cost billed on pre-subtraction total, session totals do not double-count, AI SDK v4 nested shape handled).

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14426 (Cline reasoning token double-counting fix, merged 2026-09-26 03:10 UTC), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts (Alexi TokenUsage interface L127-135, NO reasoningTokenCount field), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/sessionManager.ts (session usage summing), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/costTracker.ts (cost tracking)

- **Category**: provider + core (token accounting, usage normalization, session totals)

- **Size**: SMALL (~3-4h). Add `reasoningTokenCount?: number` to `TokenUsage` interface (src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts L127-135), extract reasoning tokens from provider response in `parseOrchestrationResponse` / `parseStreamChunk` (check OpenAI `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`, Anthropic `usage.thinking_tokens`, AI SDK v4 `usage.outputTokens.reasoning`), subtract `reasoningTokenCount` from `completion_tokens` before returning (clamp at 0), compute cost from pre-subtraction total, thread through session totals (src/core/sessionManager.ts cumulative summing, src/core/costTracker.ts), add telemetry field if applicable, write tests (subtraction, clamp, cost billing, session totals, AI SDK v4 shape).
